title: 第13章 万宝峰让人悟道的太岁土第14章 领不到菜刀渡劫境大佬赠刀
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
“走吧走吧，正好看看圣地里的风景。”
“今天必须帮师兄把杀猪刀搞到手！”
火灵儿把林东方身上的围裙解了下来，把他拽出院门。
林东方不知道火灵儿的小脑瓜里已经脑补了奇怪的东西。
在这位小师妹的脑海里，他已经成了一把杀猪刀会战十方的绝代刀客。
万宝峰距离妙音峰足有百里，他俩坐进了一艘小船，凌空飞过去。
各大主峰都给低境界弟子准备了这种小船，毕竟瑶池圣地太大了。
小船飞的不高，离地百丈左右。
飞行，是人类的梦想之一，也是林东方最向往的一件事情！
“等到我修炼有成，一定祭炼一艘大船到处飞，然后还可以在船上弄个厨房啥的…”
火灵儿无语，这位师兄的所有远大理想似乎都和厨房有关！
她打断了林东方的胡言乱语，脆声道，
“师兄，这万宝峰可热闹了，不光可以在这领取武器法宝之类的，还能把外出历练获得的宝贝放在万宝峰售卖给同门。”
“所以万宝峰是人最多的山峰之一，不少人都在那里淘宝。”
她之前几天都在瑶池圣地内到处闲逛，已经掌握了不少好玩的地方。
林东方来了兴趣，“那上面有没有人卖灵木的？”
火灵儿狐疑的看着他，“师兄，你该不会打算把灵木当柴火烧吧？”
“哪能啊，我是那种暴殄天物的人么？我要用来当菜板的。”
“嘁！”
火灵儿白了他一眼，果然还是和做饭有关。

“师兄，灵木可不便宜哦。”
“无妨，昨天离火峰和御兽峰的师叔来吃火锅，不光给了我一些灵果，还有一万灵石的红包。”
说到这里，林东方取出一枚火云果。
模样和小西红柿差不多，但是周围缭绕着像火焰一样的光华，林东方不敢下嘴。
这果子是火道修者的最爱。
“喏，这果子给你吃，我拿着都觉得烫手。”
林东方把火云果塞进火灵儿手里。
“谢谢师兄！
以后等我出去历练，一定给你搞到最好的食材和厨具！”
火灵儿欢天喜地的接过果子！
‘师兄对我也太好了，我一定要帮他打造一个世界第一厨房！
她暗暗下了一个决心！
不过她随后想到了另外一件事。
“师兄，火锅…还有么？”
馋了！
林东方笑道，“底料还有一些，等大师姐出关咱们一起吃。”
content_en:
"Let's go, let's take a look at the scenery in the Holy Land."
"I must help my senior brother get the butcher's knife today!"
Huo Ling'er took off Lin Dongfang's apron and dragged him out of the hospital.
Lin Dongfang didn't know that Huo Ling'er had already filled up his little mind with strange things.
In the mind of this little junior sister, he has become a peerless swordsman who can fight in all directions with a pig-killing knife.
Wanbao Peak is a hundred miles away from Miaoyin Peak. They got into a small boat and flew over.
All the major peaks have prepared such small boats for low-level disciples. After all, the Yaochi Holy Land is too big.
The boat didn't fly very high, about a hundred feet above the ground.
Flying is one of mankind's dreams, and it is also the thing that Lin Dongfang longs for most!
"When I succeed in my cultivation, I will definitely build a big ship to fly around, and then I can also build a kitchen on the ship..."
Huo Ling'er was speechless. All this senior brother's lofty ideals seemed to be related to the kitchen!
She interrupted Lin Dongfang's nonsense and said crisply,
"Senior brother, this Wanbaofeng is very lively. Not only can you receive weapons, magic weapons and the like here, but you can also sell the treasures you get from going out to experience at Wanbaofeng to sell to your fellow disciples."
"So Wanbaofeng is one of the most visited peaks, and many people search for treasures there."
She had been wandering around the Yaochi Holy Land in the past few days and had already mastered many interesting places.
Lin Dongfang became interested, "Is there anyone selling spiritual wood up there?"
Huo Ling'er looked at him suspiciously, "Senior brother, are you planning to burn the spiritual wood as firewood?"
"No way, am I the kind of person who wastes natural resources? I want to use it as a cutting board."
"Bang!"
Huo Ling'er rolled her eyes at him. Sure enough, it was still related to cooking.
"Senior brother, spiritual wood is not cheap."
"It's okay. The master uncles from Lihuo Peak and Yushou Peak came to have hot pot yesterday. Not only did they give me some spiritual fruits, they also gave me a red envelope of ten thousand spiritual stones."
Having said this, Lin Dongfang took out a Fire Cloud Fruit.
It looked similar to a small tomato, but it was surrounded by a flame-like brilliance, and Lin Dongfang didn't dare to bite it.
This fruit is a favorite among fire cultivators.
"Here, here is the fruit for you to eat. It feels hot to my hands even when I hold it."
Lin Dongfang put the Fire Cloud Fruit into Huo Ling'er's hand.
"Thank you, senior brother!
When I go out for training in the future, I will definitely get you the best ingredients and kitchen utensils! "
Huo Ling'er happily took the fruit!
‘Senior brother is also very kind to me. I must help him build the best kitchen in the world!
She secretly made a decision!
But then she thought of something else.
"Senior brother, hot pot...is there any more?"
Greedy!
Lin Dongfang smiled and said, "There are still some base ingredients, let's eat together when senior sister comes out of seclusion."
